title: Fixed-Grid Reversibility of High-Order Splittings for Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations with Arbitrary-Axis 3D Rotation
summary: High-order splittings for rotational nonlinear Schrödinger equations may use an exact continuous factorization of the Laplace--rotation flow, but its fixed-grid Fourier realization need not retain the symmetry required by standard symmetric compositions. For the specified realization of the 3D arbitrary-axis explicit exact integrator (EEI), we prove that the complete map has a nonzero quadratic coefficient in its local matrix logarithm for every nonzero rotation on centered even grids. The defect persists under every real consistent composition of the same unrepaired nonlinear sandwich…
